# Codex Rate Monitor v0.2.2

## Fixed

- Improved recovery when Codex sign-in expires: stale usage clears promptly,
  retry attempts are limited, and the tray's "Refresh now" command can retry
  after signing in again.
- Reduced unnecessary app-server restarts during regular usage refreshes.

## Changed

- Updated the traffic and sign-in recovery guidance in all three READMEs.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2
